stem.text: Compound $X$ is a single, pure, optical isomer. Compound $X$ is heated with an excess of concentrated $\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4$. Only **one** organic product is formed.

A.alt: Skeletal formula of a cyclohexane ring with an OH group on one carbon and two methyl groups on adjacent carbons.

B.alt: Skeletal formula of a cyclohexane ring with an OH group on one carbon and a methyl group on each of the next two carbons.

C.alt: Skeletal formula of a cyclohexane ring with a carbon bearing both OH and a methyl group, next to a carbon bearing a methyl group.

D.alt: Skeletal formula of a cyclohexane ring with a CH2OH group on one carbon and a methyl group on the adjacent carbon.
